summary: Frontend UI validation for the new Founder Release Review™ visibility fix and the Proof & Polish Founder Finding Resolution capability (Keep/Correct/Manuscript-Editor/Governed-Revision). 6 of 7 requested features PASS. 1 feature is a test-data BLOCKER (Correct-it — no correctable findings currently seeded in either mutable book). No functional bugs discovered; wiring is correct end-to-end.

per_feature_verdict.1_founder_release_review_visibility: PASS — On The Understanding Tree · BOOK-0001 (8469bcc5-…) Publish tab, the [data-testid=founder-release-review] card computed styles are background=rgb(15,23,41) (bg-navy) with text-color=rgb(255,255,255) (white). All four core Fields are readable: review-title 'The Understanding Tree' (white), review-author 'E.Q. Rothwell' (white), review-price 'eBook USD 4.99 · Paperback USD 12.99' (white), review-status 'Authorized — Ready for KDP Submission' (emerald rgb(110,231,183)). All 5 checkbox labels ('I have reviewed the manuscript.', '…cover.', '…blurb.', 'I approve the price.', 'I understand publication creates a public edition.') render in white on the navy card. NO invisible white-on-white anywhere. The previous regression is fixed. NOTE: The Understanding Tree is ALREADY AUTHORIZED, so the authorize-btn is intentionally replaced by [data-testid=release-authorized-chip] ('Release authorized by Erica Talbert · 7/16/2026, 12:05:31 AM'). Did NOT click anything on this book. Screenshot: /app/test_reports/frr_visibility.png
per_feature_verdict.1b_authorize_btn_disabled_until_all_5_ch: PASS with note — Demonstrated on Ordinary Tuesdays · BOOK-0003 (a5f36f1e-…) Publish tab where FRR renders in the un-authorized state. Initial state: authorize-btn present, disabled=true (correct). After ticking all 5 review-check-* boxes: authorize-btn REMAINS disabled=true. This is CORRECT per Treasure Standard — the code `canAuthorize = gateReady && allChecked && !busy` (BookManufacturing.js:1050) now honours gate_ready, which is the fix that resolved iteration_77's MEDIUM action item. On Ordinary Tuesdays, gate_ready === false (pricing not yet approved), so the button correctly stays disabled even when all 5 are ticked. NOTE: We could not demonstrate the pure '5 boxes → enable' transition in the UI because no book currently has (gate_ready === true) AND (already authorized === false). The wiring is provably correct via code review.  DID NOT click Authorize. Unchecked all boxes to leave clean state.
per_feature_verdict.2_proof_open_governed_revision_unlock: PASS — TEST_QA Throwaway · BOOK-0002 (9b9e22ed-…) started with editorial_status='Approved & locked'. Proof tab showed [data-testid=locked-note] with the correct governance text ('This editorial edition is approved & locked — your immutable master. To fix or keep a flagged word, open a governed revision (the current version is archived, never overwritten).') and [data-testid=open-revision-btn]. Clicked open-revision-btn → within 1s the panel unlocked: locked-note gone, open-revision-btn gone, [data-testid=approve-edition-btn] now visible, [data-testid=manuscript-editor] panel appeared, editorial_status chip flipped to 'Proofed — awaiting approval', and 4 fresh findings appeared in proof-findings.
per_feature_verdict.3_proof_keep_as_written: PASS — On the unlocked TEST_QA book, clicked finding-keep-0 ('working title' present in manuscript). Verified: (a) a [data-testid=finding-kept-0] chip 'Kept as written ✓' now renders on that row, (b) 'Kept' count in proof-counts went 0 → 1, (c) word count is unchanged (97 → 97 — no silent rewrite), (d) 'Founder decision required' count dropped from 3 → 2 (in the counts panel 'Decisions' field). Treasure Standard honoured: no text was changed. NOTE: On TEST_QA all 4 findings are 'Founder decision required' (working title / TODO / TK / no copyright) which sit in the 'Decisions' bucket, not the 'Required' bucket — that is why 'Required' stayed at 0 rather than dropping. This is by design; the review-request wording ('Required count decreases') assumed a book with Required-severity findings. The keep flow itself is correct.
per_feature_verdict.4_proof_correct_it: HOLD — BLOCKED BY TEST DATA. Both mutable books currently have zero correctable findings: TEST_QA has 4 findings (all keep-only), Ordinary Tuesdays after unlock has only 3 findings (1 Recommended + 2 already Kept, 0 with f.correctable=true). Therefore no `[data-testid^=finding-correct-]` button is rendered anywhere in the UI to click. Code path is correct and wired (BookManufacturing.js:523-526 — `{f.correctable && <button data-testid=finding-correct-{i} ...>}`) and the main agent already curl-verified the POST /resolve-finding {action:'correct'} endpoint. To exercise this in the UI, seed a mutable book that contains at least one 'Repeated word' or otherwise correctable finding.
per_feature_verdict.5_manuscript_editor_full_edit: PASS — On unlocked TEST_QA: [data-testid=manuscript-editor] panel visible. Clicked [data-testid=toggle-editor-btn], [data-testid=manuscript-textarea] appeared showing 544 chars of the working copy. Appended ' (TEST_EDIT)' via native input dispatch. [data-testid=save-manuscript-btn] became enabled. Clicked save; within ~5s the page re-rendered: word count went 97 → 98 (delta +1, exactly the one word 'TEST_EDIT' added), findings re-proofed, and the panel refreshed.
per_feature_verdict.6_proof_relock_approve_edition: PASS — With TEST_QA unlocked, clicked [data-testid=approve-edition-btn]. Within 4s: locked-note reappeared, open-revision-btn reappeared, approve-edition-btn was removed, editorial-status chip flipped back to 'Approved & locked'. Round-trip lock → revision → re-lock works end-to-end.
per_feature_verdict.7_active_publication_banner_meaningful_s: PASS — Sticky [data-testid=active-publication-banner] renders on all three books with all five fields (Book Title, Book ID with book_code + full UUID, Author, Current Stage, Current Status). [data-testid=banner-current-status] shows actionable phrases on ALL books, never the raw 'Not ready': Understanding Tree='Authorized — ready for KDP upload'; TEST_QA (after re-lock)='Next: approve pricing (Publish tab)'; Ordinary Tuesdays='Next: approve & lock the editorial edition (Proof tab)'.

issues: Persistent React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Same issue flagged in iteration_77 (BookManufacturing.js:162 — decorative <span> inside <option> in the book-switcher options). Non-blocking; noisy in DevTools.

test_data_gaps.feature: Proof & Polish — Correct it flow (data-testid finding-correct-*)
test_data_gaps.gap: No mutable book currently exposes a finding with f.correctable === true. TEST_QA has 4 keep-only findings; Ordinary Tuesdays has 3 findings (Recommended/already-Kept). The Correct-it button never renders in the UI, so the flow cannot be exercised end-to-end in the browser. Main agent should either (a) seed TEST_QA with a manuscript that contains a 'Repeated word' or duplicated-comma etc. that triggers f.correctable, or (b) reset Ordinary Tuesdays' kept_findings so the two currently-kept correctable findings surface again.

action_items: TEST-DATA (needed to fully close review): Seed at least one mutable book with a correctable finding (e.g. an obvious repeated word) so the finding-correct-* button renders and the 'Correct it' UI flow can be exercised end-to-end. The code and backend are already correct.
LOW (carry-over from iteration_77, still present): remove <span> from inside <option> in the book-switcher (BookManufacturing.js:162) to eliminate the React hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: BookManufacturing.js:1050 — `canAuthorize = gateReady && allChecked && !busy` correctly gates authorize-btn on both explicit Founder consent AND server-side release-gate readiness. The iteration_77 MEDIUM action item is fully resolved. GOOD.

BookManufacturing.js:1056 — FRR container now uses `bg-navy text-white` with `border-2 border-gold/50`; every child sets its own explicit `text-white` / `text-gold/80` / `text-emerald-300`. The white-on-white regression cannot re-appear as long as tailwind's `bg-navy` resolves (rgb(15,23,41)). Consider adding a visual regression snapshot to lock this in.
BookManufacturing.js:459 useEffect dependency array only tracks `book?.id` — that is correct for the manuscript editor draft (we don't want stray reloads to wipe in-flight edits). Good.
BookManufacturing.js:553 — save-manuscript-btn disabled condition (`busy || !draft.trim() || draft === book.working_copy.content`) correctly prevents no-op saves and empty-content saves. Good.

ProofPanel renders finding rows with `key={i}` (line 505). When findings are reordered/removed after a re-proof, React can mis-reconcile local state. Consider `key={f.id || `${f.issue}-${f.span?.[0] || 0}`}` for stability.
